title: A human can reject a compiled plan: REJECT on the plan gate sends the goal back to planning with the reason
description:
Filed by session moe-next-67 for the owner (2026-09-04), sibling of the epic-8ebe6417 rows.

PRODUCT GAP, measured at main 68eb1c5d: the only answer to a compiled plan is approving it. `approval.decide_intent` accepts `decision` in `["APPROVE", "REJECT"]` at ingress (apps/daemon/src/planning/approval-intent.ts:91 DECISIONS) but refuses every non-APPROVE before any effect (approval-intent.ts:196-198 `if (intent.decision !== "APPROVE") return refuse(null, "BOOTSTRAP_PAYLOAD_INVALID", "DAEMON_PREREQUISITE")`), so a committed approval is APPROVE by construction and no REJECT ever reaches the ledger. The plan-review screen renders one control (apps/control-room/src/v2/goals/approve-plan-gate.tsx `ApproveGate`: `cr.approve.button`), Needs you's PLAN_APPROVAL item carries only an open-board action (needs-you-model.ts), and the goal status stage PLAN says "approve to start the agents" (goal-status.ts:117-121). Core's only REJECTED transition for a planning run is `rejectRun(state, commandId, findingsRef, successorRunId)` (packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-*.ts), which expects a successor run; nothing on the daemon mints one. A human who reads a bad decomposition today can only abandon the goal or approve work they do not want.

FEATURE: REJECT as a first-class decision on the same wire. `approval.decide_intent {decision: "REJECT", decisionReason, runId}` commits a durable rejection (architect chooses the mechanism and states why: (i) the intent decision's own result carries `decision: REJECT` + reason and the run stays PLAN_REVIEW with `planState: REJECTED` derived in the offer ladder and the goal catalog, or (ii) core `rejectRun` with a successor planning run minted by the daemon so the compiler seat is re-staffed on the same goal with the reason in its mission between the `<<<OPERATOR INSTRUCTIONS` markers, the way PR #20 carries replan findings). Either way: the surface withdraws `approval.decide_intent` for the rejected run and re-offers `planning.submit_decomposition` for the goal; the compiler mission quotes the rejection reason; the next submission is a fresh plan (new run version or successor run) that the human approves or rejects again. UI: the plan gate gains a Reject control with a required reason (`cr.approve.reject`, `cr.approve.reason.input`); Needs you gains a NEEDS_YOU kind for a rejected plan awaiting re-planning (roster `NEEDS_YOU_KINDS` updated, needs-you-model.ts:27); the board header stage gains `PLAN_REJECTED` with STAGE_WORDS "Plan sent back" and next-step "Waiting for a new plan"; the decision feed says "the operator rejected the plan" (activity `verdict` REJECT already wired for approval kinds in activity-words.ts decisionWords - the server must now emit it: activity-read.ts verdictOf gains the approval kinds reading the committed result's `decision`).

Out of scope: rejecting the Product Contract (Gate 1 has its own clarification path); multi-node ordering (task-4423d2a4).
definitionOfDone: `approval.decide_intent` with `decision: "REJECT"` and a non-empty `decisionReason` COMMITS a durable record (event kind or decision result named by the architect) and never mints an activation; with an empty reason it refuses `APPROVAL_REJECT_REASON_REQUIRED` (code + layer asserted); the APPROVE arm is byte-identical (its existing tests unchanged, count line quoted).

After a REJECT: `/affordances/read` no longer offers `approval.decide_intent` for that run and offers `planning.submit_decomposition` for the goal again; the compiler mission text for the re-staffed seat contains the rejection reason verbatim between the operator-instruction markers (mission-text test); the next accepted submission produces a plan the human can approve (e2e over a REAL daemon with a scripted seat double: submit -> reject -> resubmit -> approve -> node offered).

`/activity/read` entries for `approval.decide_intent` carry `verdict` APPROVE or REJECT read from the committed result (activity-read.test.ts), and the board feed renders "rejected the plan" with a bad tone (board-screen.test.tsx).

Control room: the plan gate renders Reject with a required reason and dispatches the same offer with REJECT; Needs you lists the rejected plan under its new kind until a new plan is submitted; the board header reads "Plan sent back"; Playwright journey against a REAL daemon covers reject -> new plan -> approve (`pnpm test:e2e:browser` count line quoted).

Live drive on UnAI: a compiled plan rejected from the browser with a reason, the re-staffed seat's new plan submitted and approved; decision ids + the seat transcript excerpt quoting the reason in a row comment; README plan-approval clause and the runbook's approval paragraph updated.
Gates quoted with their count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm test:security`.
taskRails: FULL VERTICAL SLICE (human DoD 2026-09-04): this row ships daemon + control-room UI + tests + docs for its feature and carries NO dependsOn on any sibling row.
FEATURES ONLY (human DoD 2026-09-04): no security-boundary or policy work in this row; the verifier stays the documented trusted-workspace verifier.

HUMAN GATES ARE HUMAN-ONLY: the REJECT decision rides the existing operator-only, MCP-excluded approval wire and mints a human-review witness exactly as APPROVE does; a test pins that an MCP caller cannot reject.

PROVE IT LIVE: besides an offline e2e over a REAL daemon (no fixtures), completion records a live drive on the lane (UnAI at D:/projexts/UnAI, launched by scripts/up.ps1) with the decision ids in a row comment.
